title: Os Misteriosos Nós da Nebulosa da Hélice
titleEn: Curious Cometary Knots in the Helix Nebula
titleEs: Los Misteriosos Nudos de la Nebulosa de la Hélice
caption: A Nebulosa da Hélice, uma das mais próximas de nós, revela estruturas enigmáticas chamadas nós cometários que ainda intrigam os cientistas. Esses aglomerados de gás e poeira têm tamanho gigantesco, apesar de possuírem massa semelhante à da Terra. O Telescópio James Webb capturou detalhes impressionantes em luz infravermelha, mostrando como ventos estelares poderosos do núcleo da nebulosa podem fragmentar e moldar essas estruturas notáveis.
captionEn: What causes unusual knots of gas and dust in planetary nebulas?  Seen also in the Ring Nebula, the Dumbbell Nebula and NGC 2392, the knots' existence was not initially predicted, and their origins are still not well understood.  Pictured here is a fascinating image of part of the Helix Nebula by the James Webb Space Telescope showing tremendous detail in infrared light. The cometary knots have masses similar to the Earth but have sizes typically several times the orbit of Pluto.  One hypothesis for the fragmentation and evolution of the knots includes existing gas being driven out by a less dense but highly energetic stellar wind of the central evolving star.  The Helix Nebula is one of the closest examples of a planetary nebula created at the end of the life of a Sun-like star.  Given a technical designation of NGC 7293, the Helix Nebula lies about 650 light-years away towards the constellation of Water Carrier (Aquarius). captionEs: La Nebulosa de la Hélice, una de las más cercanas a nosotros, revela estructuras enigmáticas llamadas nudos cometarios que aún intrigan a los científicos. Estos aglomerados de gas y polvo tienen un tamaño gigantesco, a pesar de poseer una masa similar a la de la Tierra. El Telescopio James Webb capturó detalles impresionantes en luz infrarroja, mostrando cómo los vientos estelares poderosos del núcleo de la nebulosa pueden fragmentar y moldear estas notables estructuras.
